description: Dreadnaught Waistguard Level 60 Korfax at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands will make a Dreadnaught Waistguard if you bring him the following items: 1 Desecrated Waistguard, 8 Wartorn Plate Scraps, 1 Arcanite Bar and 5 Cured Rugged Hides. Requirements: - Desecrated Waistguard - Wartorn Plate Scrap x 8 - Arcanite Bar - Cured Rugged Hide x 5
name: Dreadnaught Waistguard
